# AI Affairs covers the unveiling of VideoGen Model 1


AI Affairs covered the unveiling of VideoGen Model 1, its approach to longer videos, and the $1 million credit program.


AI Affairs reported on the unveiling of VideoGen Model 1 after speaking with co-founder and CEO Anton Koenig.


The article explores Model 1's approach to planning multi-shot videos from a single prompt, its creative direction system, and the $1 million credit program for selected projects.


This is independent reporting on the announcement. AI Affairs had not tested the model before publication, and its article distinguishes VideoGen's claims from independently verified results.


[Read the coverage in AI Affairs](https://www.aiaffairs.com/technology/videogen-model-1-ten-minute-ai-video-one-prompt/) .


[Explore Model 1 and its example videos](https://videogen.io/model-1) .
